findings.issue: Test imports stdlib `tomllib` (Python 3.11+) but pyproject.toml:10 declares `requires-python = ">=3.10"`. On a supported 3.10 interpreter the whole test module fails with ModuleNotFoundError, breaking 'existing tests still pass'. The green run was only proved on 3.13.5; build-1.md itself notes the 3.11+ requirement without resolving it.
findings.fix: Read the pyproject version without tomllib (e.g. regex on the `version = "..."` line under [project]), or guard with try/except ImportError + skipUnless, or raise requires-python to >=3.11 with a recorded decision. Rerun the suite on 3.10 if available.
